name: Drone planning
description: Advisory drone flight planning overlay for Australia: airspace, aerodromes, fire hazards, weather and aircraft, with a CASR Part 101 pilot checklist. Planning guidance only.
author: Dread905

permissions.detail: SQLite cache and the aerodromes.json dataset

settings.label: OpenAIP API key
settings.help: Free key from openaip.net. Used server-side for airspace and airport context; never sent to the browser. Without it the plan still shows fire, weather, aircraft and any local aerodrome data.
